description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Gaz.Ex.Ord. No. 1482/26 of 02.02.2007 adding Departments to Radiology, University of Peradeniya
reasoning: This gazette content involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under statutory powers (Section 27(1)) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Peradeniya. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing a legal amendment rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
